guidance: Fresh 80/80 Ironclad A0 with starter deck plus Impervious, 99 gold and no potion. Astra's exact route enters the row-1 left Monster at col2, which leads to another early Monster and later a Rest or Elite choice; collect early useful card rewards before considering an elite. In combat, use fresh intents and damage previews: prioritize a guaranteed kill when it removes an attack, and use Bash Vulnerable when the target will survive and follow-up attacks benefit. Impervious costs 2 and grants large one-turn block before exhausting; spend it against substantial current damage rather than a harmless intent. Burning Blood heals 6 after victory, but avoid taking large cumulative losses for marginal damage. Do not end a turn with a legal survival line that avoids lethal. Use a potion if it prevents about 8+ HP loss or enables a decisive kill; do not wait until 1 HP. At the card reward, favor efficient immediate damage, reliable block, draw/energy or strong exhaust synergy with Impervious; skip weak additions. Re-read hand and target indices after every action. This plan ends at the next MAP.
